name: Caspian
source:
Caspian owns a woodworking store in Sid Caeham called the “Eclipse”.

Once a great believer of adventure, and an owner of a free spirit, this character has since moved on to hide away from his past.

He doesn’t want to get involved in anything that will take him away from his quiet life.

[Edited from the [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/10C18D9dLZ_jKI1p7anhfTTnWz5Nkdzt36bNyxHIqcFQ]casting submission form[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Caspian.[/spoiler]
